app.name: Tinder Dating App: Date & Chat
app.description: The world's most popular dating app for meeting new people, with millions of users nearby and around the globe.

verdict.one_liner: Tinder may collect your face geometry, government ID, and sensitive profile details, and states that it shares your data with Match Group affiliates and advertising partners.
verdict.summary: Tinder collects extensive personal data including account details, profile information, content you share, and usage behavior. It may collect sensitive profile data, face geometry for verification features, and government-issued ID. It generates insights and inferences about your preferences and behavior, and shares data with Match Group affiliates, service providers, advertisers, and law enforcement. Users can delete their account but data may be retained for safety and legal reasons.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Tinder's data collection includes optional biometric verification and sensitive profile details, and it shares data broadly across Match Group companies and with advertisers. If privacy matters to you, consider whether the risks are acceptable.

red.title: May collect sensitive profile details
red.plain_english: Tinder states that some profile data you choose to provide may be considered sensitive or special in certain countries, such as details about sexual orientation, sexual life, health, or political beliefs.

red.title: Collects face geometry for verification
red.plain_english: Tinder states that certain features like Photo Verification, Photo Check, and ID + Photo Verification involve the collection of face geometry data, which may be considered biometric data in some jurisdictions.

red.title: May require government-issued ID
red.plain_english: Tinder states that you may provide a copy of your government-issued ID to help it check that you are who you say you are.

red.title: Shares your data with Match Group companies
red.plain_english: Tinder states that it shares data about you with Match Group affiliates and that they share data about you with Tinder. This includes cross-platform safety enforcement and service improvement.

red.title: Collects precise GPS location if permitted
red.plain_english: Tinder states that it collects your geolocation latitude and longitude from your device if you give permission. If you decline, certain features will not be available.

red.title: Pulls data from linked social media accounts
red.plain_english: Tinder states that you may share data with it through your accounts on other platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, Spotify, Apple, and LinkedIn, including photos, playlists, and profile information.

green.title: Requires users to be at least 18
green.plain_english: Tinder states that its service is restricted to individuals who are at least 18 years old.

green.title: You can delete your account
green.plain_english: Tinder states that you can delete your account and data, though a safety retention window applies.

green.title: You can decline precise geolocation
green.plain_english: Tinder states that it asks for permission before accessing your precise GPS location, and that you can decline.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that you share photos, videos, and audio on the service. It does not explicitly describe how camera and microphone access work on your device.
categories.detail: The policy states that users share photos, videos, and audio content. It does not explicitly mention camera or microphone permissions, background access, or recording mechanisms.
categories.policy_excerpt: You share photos, videos, audio, text and other types of content, such as your search queries or chats with other members.
concerns: No explicit mention of camera/microphone access mechanism

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that it collects your precise GPS location if you give permission, and that some features will not work if you decline. It may still infer approximate location from your IP address and network data.
categories.detail: Precise geolocation is collected only with permission. If declined, core features are limited. Approximate location is still inferred from IP and network data.
categories.policy_excerpt: If you give us permission, we can collect your geolocation (latitude and longitude) from your device. If you decline permission, certain features that rely on precise geolocation will not be available to you.
concerns: Approximate location inferred from IP even when GPS is declined

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that you may choose to share information about other people, such as contact details, for certain features. It does not clearly explain whether your full contact list is uploaded to its servers.
categories.detail: Contact sharing is optional and used for specific features like reports or queries involving other members. The policy does not explicitly describe uploading the full phonebook.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you choose to share with us information about other people (for example, if you use the contact details of someone you know for a given feature or if you submit a query or report involving a member), we process this data on your behalf to complete your request.
concerns: Limited detail on how contacts are processed or stored

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that you share photos, videos, audio, and text when you use the service. It does not indicate broad library scanning or background file access.
categories.detail: File and media access is user-initiated for uploading content to the service. No indication of broad library scanning or background access.
categories.policy_excerpt: You share photos, videos, audio, text and other types of content, such as your search queries or chats with other members.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that it shares your data with service providers, advertising partners, Match Group affiliates, and law enforcement when legally required. It also states that your data may be transferred in a merger or acquisition.
categories.detail: Data is shared with Match Group affiliates, service providers, advertisers, and law enforcement. Mergers and acquisitions may result in data transfers.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also share data with service providers and partners who assist us in operating the service, with other Match Group companies for the reasons laid out below and, in some cases, for legal and related reasons... We may transfer your data if we are involved, whether in whole or in part, in a merger, sale, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, reorganization, dissolution, bankruptcy or other change of ownership or control.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Tinder collects your phone number, email, and date of birth to create an account. It states that you may provide a government-issued ID for verification, and that you may share data from linked social media accounts.
categories.detail: Registration requires phone number, email, and date of birth. Optional government ID may be requested for verification. Social media login imports profile data from linked accounts.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you create an account, you give us basic information for your account to be set up such as your phone number, email address, and date of birth... You may provide us with a copy of your government-issued ID to help us check that you're who you say you are.
concerns: Social media login imports external data

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that it collects information about how you use the service, including features you use, ads you interact with, and how you interact with others. It says it generates insights and inferences about your preferences, behavior, and attitudes, and shares certain information with advertising partners.
categories.detail: Usage data including login times, features used, actions taken, ads interacted with, and interactions with others is collected. Insights and inferences are generated for advertising and personalization. Advertising IDs and cookies are used for tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: Using the service generates data about your activity, including how you use it (e.g., when you logged in, features you've been using, actions taken, information shown to you, referring webpages, ads you interacted with) and how you interact with others... Using the service involves the generation of insights and inferences, drawn from your interactions... reflecting, e.g., your preferences, characteristics, predispositions, behavior, and attitudes.
concerns: Behavioral data used for ad targeting
Insights and inferences generated from all activity

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that its service is restricted to individuals who are at least 18 years old.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly requires users to be 18 or older. No under-18 users are permitted. This is appropriate for a dating app.
categories.policy_excerpt: Our service is restricted to individuals who are 18 years of age or older. We do not permit individuals under the age of 18 on our platform.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Tinder collects your IP address, network information, and device data when you use the service. It states that it uses this for security, analytics, and advertising.
categories.detail: IP address, network information, and device data are collected continuously. Used for security, analytics, and ad targeting.
categories.policy_excerpt: Using the service involves the collection of data from and about the device(s) you use to access our service, including hardware and software information such as IP address, device ID, device type, operating systems and configurations, network information.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that it collects device information including advertising IDs and identifiers associated with cookies or other technologies that can uniquely identify your device or browser.
categories.detail: Advertising IDs, cookie identifiers, and device-specific identifiers are collected for ad targeting and security.
categories.policy_excerpt: advertising IDs and identifiers associated with cookies or other technologies that can uniquely identify a device or browser.

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that it collects face geometry data for optional verification features, which may be considered biometric data. It also states that your profile may include sensitive information such as sexual orientation, sexual life, health, or political beliefs if you choose to provide it.
categories.detail: Face geometry is collected for Photo Verification, Photo Check, and ID + Photo Verification. Sensitive profile data may include health and political beliefs. Washington and Nevada have a separate Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy supplement.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may choose to participate in certain of our features like Photo Verification, Photo Check, or ID + Photo Verification, that involve the collection of face geometry data, which may be considered biometric data in some jurisdictions.
concerns: Health and sensitive data may be in user profiles

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that it keeps transaction details when you make purchases. If you pay directly rather than through Apple or Google, you provide your debit or credit card number or other financial information.
categories.detail: Transaction details are kept for purchases and refunds. Direct payments (not via Apple/Google) require debit/credit card or other financial info.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you pay directly with us (rather than through a platform such as iOS or Android), you provide your debit or credit card number or other financial info.
concerns: Payment card data collected for direct payments

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that you can delete your account, but implements a safety retention window of three months after account closure or one year after an account ban. It may also retain some data for legal compliance.
categories.detail: Account deletion is available. A 3-month safety retention window applies after closure (1 year after ban). Legal compliance may require longer retention for some data.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can also close your account as explained here and we'll delete your data as laid out in this Privacy Policy... we implement a safety retention window of three months following account closure or one year following an account ban.
concerns: Safety retention window applies after deletion
Some data retained for legal compliance

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Tinder states that it will notify you before material privacy policy changes take effect, but your continued use of the service after the effective date constitutes acceptance.
categories.detail: Material changes are notified in advance. Continued use after the effective date equals acceptance. Some changes may require affirmative acceptance.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will notify you before material changes take effect so that you have time to review the changes... Your continued access or use of our Services after the effective date of the Terms constitutes your consent to any changes.
